tools.name: fl_get_mix_overview
tools.description: Read the FL Studio mixer: tempo (bpm) and every used mixer track (index 0 = master) with volume_db (dB), pan_pct (-100 left .. 100 right), stereo_width_pct, muted, solo, the built-in 3-band EQ (band low/mid/high, gain_db, freq_hz) and plugin names. Read-only. Set include_empty=true to also list unused default 'Insert N' tracks.

tools.name: fl_set_track
tools.description: Change ONE mixer track (needs user approval). Arguments: track (track index or name, e.g. 'Kick' or 0 for master); then any of: volume_change_db (relative change in dB, e.g. -2 for 'down 2 dB'), volume_db (absolute level in dB, -60..5), pan_pct (-100 = hard left, 100 = hard right, 0 = centre), stereo_width_pct (-100..100), and for the built-in EQ: eq_band ('low'|'mid'|'high') with eq_gain_db (-12..12 dB; an EQ cut or boost is eq_gain_db, never volume_change_db) and/or eq_freq_hz (20..20000 Hz). Use ONLY these argument names; numbers must be numbers. Returns before/after readback and verified.

tools.name: fl_undo
tools.description: Undo a change made by fl_set_track (needs user approval). Optional change_id; default is the last change. Restores the stored values and returns the readback.

tools.name: fl_watch_peaks
tools.description: Play the song and watch mixer peak meters to find clipping or tracks running too hot. Arguments: seconds (2..300, default 30), start_playback (default true), from_bar (default 1). Returns per-track max_peak_dbfs and clip_count, the clipping track indices, and suggested volume_change_db trims.

tools.name: analyze_audio
tools.description: Measure an exported WAV. Required: path (absolute path of the mix WAV). Optional: reference_path (absolute path of a reference track to compare against). Returns integrated/short-term loudness (LUFS), loudness range (LU), true peak (dBTP), sample peak (dBFS), crest (dB), stereo correlation, spectral centroid (Hz), 7 band levels (dB) and an analysis_id to pass to diagnose_complaint or verify_fix.

tools.name: diagnose_complaint
tools.description: Turn a plain-language complaint about the mix (e.g. 'too bright', 'muddy', 'sounds bad') into measured findings and proposed fl_set_track changes. Required: complaint (the user's words, e.g. 'too bright') AND analysis_id (from analyze_audio). Optional: track (track index or name). Prefer this tool for vague complaints. If it returns needs_clarification=true, ask the user its question and options and propose no changes.

tools.name: verify_fix
tools.description: Check whether a fix worked. Required: complaint (the original complaint, e.g. 'too bright'), before_analysis_id (the analysis_id of the mix before the fix) AND after_path (absolute path of the re-exported WAV). Returns passed and per-check before/after values.

tools.name: analyze_midi
tools.description: Analyze an exported MIDI file. Required: path (absolute .mid path). Optional: track (MIDI track number, integer). Returns the detected key and confidence, out-of-key notes, timing offsets from the grid (ms), velocity spread and flags such as 'robotic'.

tools.name: fix_midi
tools.description: Fix a MIDI file (needs user approval). Required: path (absolute .mid path) and fix, one of 'snap_to_scale' (move out-of-key notes into the key), 'quantize' (snap timing to a grid) or 'humanize' (add small timing/velocity variation). Optional: grid_beats in quarter-note beats (1 = quarter notes, 0.5 = 8th notes, 0.25 = 16th notes, 0.125 = 32nd notes; set it whenever the user names a note value), key like 'C major' or 'A minor', strength_pct 0..100. Writes a new .mid and a piano-roll script the user applies in FL.

tools.name: fl_play_midi
tools.description: Play a MIDI phrase on the selected FL instrument. Give EITHER path (absolute .mid path) OR notes (list of {pitch 0..127, start_beat, length_beats, velocity}), never both. Optional channel (global channel index). record=true records into the piano roll and needs user approval; record=false just plays it live. start_bar is the bar number where the recording starts (>= 2, default 2); set it when the user names a bar.
